Confirmed: `recordRead(ReferenceEntry, long)` at guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java:2542-2547 adds the entry to the `recencyQueue` field (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue`, line 1948) without acquiring the segment lock; `drainRecencyQueue()` (line 2590-2602, `@GuardedBy("this")`) later drains that queue under the lock to reorder the access list.

ANSWER: On a read, `Segment.recordRead(entry, now)` offers the accessed entry to the lock-free `recencyQueue` (a `ConcurrentLinkedQueue<ReferenceEntry<K,V>>` field on `Segment`) instead of touching the access-order list directly; the segment later acquires its lock and calls `Segment.drainRecencyQueue()` to poll all entries off that queue and replay them into the LRU access list.
